scope: primary court document archive, catalog, repeat import and temporal context
fixes_and_checks: Bounded archive reads and manifest schema validation; duplicate IDs, traversal, symlinks, malformed hashes and unofficial URL hosts rejected
Original and extracted-text SHA-256, PDF signature, first-page date/number/identity terms and full page-map coverage checked
Archive metadata cannot promote current legal validity, completeness or lawyer review
Typed sanitized HTTP 503 for server-owned archive failures without breaking health or ordinary matter documents
Idempotent source import scoped to matter; eight concurrent retries create one document/original/index
Rights and original byte hash rechecked before reuse; write access still required
Malformed nested evidence IDs produce validation errors rather than SQLite binding exceptions
Capture dates and archival edition labels reach retrieved context and model prompts; explicit warnings shown in answers
limitations: Archived Plenum explanations do not complete the primary legislative corpus or its revision histories
A quoted amendment mention is not a verified complete chain of amendments
Byte/text/metadata checks do not establish current legal applicability or correctness of legal conclusions
Prompt constraints and mock tests do not prove real model resistance or semantic accuracy
Independent legal review and live deployment acceptance remain open
